root.label: Villena Museum Bronze Age gold theft

events.label: Villena Museum Bronze Age gold theft

slots.name: raid duration
slots.sentence: "The alarm at the Villena Museum went off around 5:20 a.m.," said a spokesman for the town council, adding that within four minutes, they had all left the building again in an extremely rapid and professional operation.

slots.name: collection objects
slots.sentence: The Treasure of Villena is a collection of more than 50 mainly gold objects, discovered in 1963 by archaeologist Jose Maria Soler in a sunken vessel in a dried out riverbed.

slots.name: remaining crowns
slots.sentence: Mayor Cerdan said that only three silver vessels, a bracelet, an earring and one of four crowns in the collection — which the thieves appeared to have "dropped" while making their exit — remained behind.

slots.name: gold value
slots.sentence: The mayor said the gold alone would be worth around €1.7 million or $2 million.

slots.name: replica sets
slots.sentence: The collection has been exhibited beyond Villena in cities including Madrid, Alicante, Tokyo and Kyoto, and two sets of replicas were later made to showcase the collection without taking it away from the armored display at the Villena Archaeological Museum.

slots.name: gold bowls
slots.sentence: The gold pieces include 11 bowls, three bottles and 28 bracelets.

slots.name: collection age
slots.sentence: The collection was discovered more than 60 years ago and is thought to be a little more than 3,000 years old

slots.name: meteor pieces
slots.sentence: two pieces crafted from a metal that recent studies showed hailed from a meteor.
